reference: Unmodified local Tcl 8.6.15 via Python tkinter

rows.name: write-read
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt w+]; fconfigure $f -translation lf; puts $f hello; seek $f 0; set s [read $f]; close $f; set s

rows.name: unicode-lines
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt w+]; fconfigure $f -translation lf; puts $f 中文; puts $f second; seek $f 0; set n [gets $f a]; set m [gets $f b]; set e [gets $f c]; close $f; list $n $a $m $b $e $c

rows.name: append
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt a]; fconfigure $f -translation lf; puts $f next; close $f; set f [open sample.txt]; set s [read $f]; close $f; set s

rows.name: partial-read
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; set a [read $f 2]; set p [tell $f]; set b [read $f 2]; close $f; list $a $p $b

rows.name: read-zero
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; set s [read $f 0]; set p [tell $f]; close $f; list $s $p

rows.name: eof
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; set a [eof $f]; read $f 3; set b [eof $f]; read $f 1; set c [eof $f]; seek $f 0; set d [eof $f]; close $f; list $a $b $c $d

rows.name: nonewline
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; set s [read -nonewline $f]; close $f; set s

rows.name: empty
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; set n [gets $f line]; set e [eof $f]; close $f; list $n $line $e

rows.name: crlf
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; set a [gets $f]; set b [gets $f]; close $f; list $a $b

rows.name: lf-translation
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; fconfigure $f -translation lf; set s [read $f]; close $f; set s

rows.name: seek-relative
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt]; seek $f -2 end; set a [read $f 1]; seek $f -2 current; set b [read $f 1]; close $f; list $a $b

rows.name: flush
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt w]; fconfigure $f -translation lf; puts -nonewline $f abc; flush $f; set n [file size sample.txt]; close $f; set n

rows.name: rplus
rows.source: set f [open sample.txt r+]; fconfigure $f -translation lf; seek $f 2; puts -nonewline $f XY; seek $f 0; set s [read $f]; close $f; set s

rows.name: source-return
rows.source: set result [source part.tcl]; list $result $x

rows.name: source-local
rows.source: proc p {} {set x 1; set result [source part.tcl]; list $result $x}; p

rows.name: source-script-name
rows.source: set result [source part.tcl]; list $result [info script]

rows.name: source-error-restores
rows.source: list [catch {source part.tcl}] [info script]

rows.name: source-nested
rows.source: source part.tcl

rows.name: file-paths
rows.source: list [file tail dir/a.txt] [file dirname dir/a.txt] [file extension dir/a.txt] [file rootname dir/a.txt] [file join dir sub a.txt]

rows.name: mkdir-cd
rows.source: file mkdir sub; cd sub; set f [open data.txt w]; close $f; list [file tail [pwd]] [file exists data.txt] [file isfile data.txt] [file isdirectory .]

rows.name: copy-rename-delete
rows.source: file copy a.txt b.txt; file rename b.txt c.txt; file delete c.txt; list [file exists a.txt] [file exists b.txt] [file exists c.txt]

rows.name: missing-file
rows.source: catch {open missing.txt r}

rows.name: closed-channel
rows.source: set f [open a.txt w]; close $f; catch {puts $f broken}

rows.name: readonly
rows.source: set f [open a.txt r]; set result [catch {puts $f bad}]; close $f; set result

rows.name: package-provide
rows.source: package provide demo 1.2; list [package provide demo] [package require demo 1.0] [package present -exact demo 1.2]

rows.name: package-version
rows.source: list [package vcompare 1.2 1.2.0] [package vcompare 1.2 1.10] [package vsatisfies 1.3 1.2] [package vsatisfies 2.0 1.0]

rows.name: package-load
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.2 {source demo.tcl}; list [package require demo 1.0] [greet]

rows.name: package-global-scope
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.0 {set loaded global; package provide demo 1.0}; proc p {} {package require demo; info exists loaded}; list [p] $loaded

rows.name: package-best-version
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.0 {package provide demo 1.0}; package ifneeded demo 1.5 {package provide demo 1.5}; package ifneeded demo 2.0 {package provide demo 2.0}; package require demo 1.1

rows.name: package-exact
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.0 {package provide demo 1.0}; package ifneeded demo 1.5 {package provide demo 1.5}; package require -exact demo 1.0

rows.name: package-load-once
rows.source: set n 0; package ifneeded demo 1.0 {incr n; package provide demo 1.0}; package require demo; package require demo; set n

rows.name: package-conflict
rows.source: package provide demo 1.2; catch {package require demo 2.0}

rows.name: package-present-does-not-load
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.0 {package provide demo 1.0}; list [catch {package present demo}] [package provide demo]

rows.name: package-forget
rows.source: package provide demo 1.0; package forget demo; package provide demo

rows.name: package-missing-provide
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.0 {set x 1}; catch {package require demo}

rows.name: package-cycle
rows.source: package ifneeded demo 1.0 {package require demo}; catch {package require demo}

rows.name: source-return-level
rows.source: proc p {} {source part.tcl; return wrong}; p

rows.name: source-error-code
rows.source: catch {source part.tcl}

rows.name: source-break
rows.source: set n 0; foreach x {1 2 3} {incr n; source part.tcl}; set n

rows.name: binary-roundtrip
rows.source: set f [open bytes.dat w+]; fconfigure $f -translation binary; set data {}; for {set i 0} {$i<256} {incr i} {append data [format %c $i]}; puts -nonewline $f $data; seek $f 0; set read [read $f]; close $f; list [string length $read] [expr {$read eq $data}] [file size bytes.dat]

rows.name: source-utf8
rows.source: source -encoding utf-8 part.tcl
